caveats: No regional MHW was detected: over 2004-06-01..2004-08-31 the maximum SST in the region (294.11 K, ~21.0 C) never exceeded the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold for >=5 consecutive days in any of the 3301 sea cells (of 3600 region cells; 299 land cells all-NaN). Only six isolated hot cell-days occurred (2004-08-01, 2004-08-04, 2004-08-05). Region cells are the 60x60 grid cells whose coordinates fall within the inclusive bounds (54.14..55.32 N, 14.68..15.86 E). Baseline pools for 1992-2002 used +-5 calendar-day windows, hence including 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 as prescribed.
